object.attr: analysis: for search, trace and incoming links any document could hold a match or a link, so an answer that silently leaves one out reads as complete (review Q17). `validate_repo`, `repo_health` and `suspects` already name such documents.
object.description: If a document in the repository has a load error, the MCP server shall name the document in the result of each tool call whose answer covers more than one document.
